entries.7eabdfaf22da7fbb: The company has formulated its 2026-2030 Long-Term Management Vision and aims to realize its 2030 Vision, “a business-creation group that opens up tomorrow through the power of people and technology.” As its basic strategy, it calls for a high-profit corporate group built on the growth of service-based businesses, and it says it will pursue expansion of ICT-centered service-based businesses, the provision of new value by combining IT solutions with the Canon product business, and the establishment of new pillar businesses through stronger investment functions. It also states that its challenges are further strengthening the profitability of the Canon product business and expanding revenue alongside improved profitability of the IT solutions business, which it positions as a growth business.
